text:
```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
      with:
        php-version: '7.4'
        extensions: pdo_mysql, mbstring, xml, zip, curl

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist

    - name: Run PHPUnit
      run: vendor/bin/phpunit --version && vendor/bin/phpunit

    - name: Run PHP-CS-Fixer
      run: vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer --version && vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run
```

This GitHub Actions workflow sets up a PHP environment using the latest version of PHP 7.4, installs dependencies via Composer, and then runs PHPUnit and PHP-CS-Fixer. The workflow is triggered on pushes and pull requests to the main branch.
